selection_basis.variant_rule: Use exact preregistered variants with nontrivial stressed evidence; retain an adjacent PRICE_BREAKOUT pair for fixed local parameter sensitivity; do not add coordinates or retune.
selection_basis.selection_evidence_disclosure: The prior Breadth V2 development outcomes were visible when selecting these variants. They are selection evidence only. The subsequent evaluation is bound to an untouched sealed-forward window and must not be described as confirmation until that window is adjudicated.

canonical_reconciliation.ledger_status_explanation: Breadth V2 proposal and trial events are present in the append-only research ledger, but the development campaign explicitly did not append family DECISION_RECORDED events.
canonical_reconciliation.interpretation: SCREENING is the truthful generated ledger status; PASS is the truthful family-level status in the separate committed development decision artifact. PASS does not mean any exact variant is independently validated or promoted.

candidates.mechanism: Smoothed price state represents delayed trend participation.
Event-triggered channel breaks may capture directional persistence.
Event-triggered channel breaks may capture directional persistence.

assets_universe.membership_rule: fixed historical panel; no listing, liquidity, survivorship, backfill, or dynamic top-N changes

future_execution_window.pre_maturity_rule: No strategy return, benchmark comparison, family decision, or candidate promotion may be computed or recorded before maturity.

temporal_design.decision_clock: after close of completed bar t using only observations through t
temporal_design.execution_clock: target applies to return from t to t+1
temporal_design.walk_forward: none; parameters are frozen and there is no refit or retuning
temporal_design.warmup: candidate-specific causal warmup from the existing runner; warmup bars are not scored
temporal_design.gaps: fail closed; no interpolation or forward fill

costs.funding: realized event-time settlement cash flow is included identically in both modes

funding_treatment.position_boundary: funding at t settles against the prior position before the t target is computed
funding_treatment.missingness: unsupported rate types, source gaps, and coverage failures block the affected cell; never zero-fill

turnover_accounting.definition: one-way notional turnover at each rebalance; fees and slippage are charged on the same rebalance
turnover_accounting.reporting: trade count, turnover, exposure, fee, slippage, funding, and price/funding PnL are descriptive diagnostics

parameter_sensitivity.rule: No new search. Report only the already-registered local neighbors from the Breadth V2 family decision as selection context.
parameter_sensitivity.future_rule: selected parameters cannot change based on forward outcomes; evaluating neighbors in a later phase requires a separate preregistered scope

regime_decomposition.rule: calendar-window decomposition only; no outcome-derived regime labels, clustering, or ex-post regime selection

failure_kill_thresholds.integrity: any unresolved receipt, provenance, timing, non-finite, gap, or accounting failure => KILL
failure_kill_thresholds.stress_aggregate: aggregate stressed benchmark excess must be > 0
failure_kill_thresholds.stress_temporal_breadth: at least 2 of 3 historical selection windows positive, and the sealed-forward window must not be negative for PROMOTE
failure_kill_thresholds.stress_asset_breadth: at least 10 of 20 assets positive for PROMOTE
failure_kill_thresholds.concentration: no single positive asset may contribute > 35% of positive aggregate stressed excess
failure_kill_thresholds.cost_survival: stressed net-return advantage must retain at least 50% of baseline advantage
failure_kill_thresholds.blocked_data: unresolved required coverage at adjudication => KILL for the affected candidate, not deletion of the denominator

decision_rule.PROMOTE: all integrity, stress, temporal, breadth, concentration, cost-survival, and fixed-parameter sensitivity requirements pass; this means eligible for a separately authorized next evidence tier only
decision_rule.ITERATE: no hard KILL threshold fails, but a required result is inconclusive or a predeclared soft diagnostic is unresolved; iteration requires a new preregistration and does not retune this contract
decision_rule.KILL: any hard failure above, or any evidence that the candidate is not executable under the frozen timing, source, benchmark, or cost semantics

qntyagenteval_applicability.lookup_scope: committed QntyLab repository search for QntyAgentEval/qnty_agent_eval/economic evaluator contracts
qntyagenteval_applicability.action: Do not build an evaluator in this phase. Subsequent execution must use the existing Breadth V2 runner/kernel contract.

authority_boundary: exploratory_only; no scientific validation, Qnty mutation, paper/live trading, capital authority, Router, State Snapshot, JH01, or JFPV3 authority
